title: Spend all Character Pixels
description: Stamina regenerates 1 per 6 minutes (240/day). Cap stops generation. Run highest Rabbit Hole or Anomaly Zone difficulty available.

title: Claim login + event rewards
description: Open the Event page and claim everything. Streak bonuses break if you miss a day. Check active redeem codes too.

title: Daily Quests (Activity 100)
description: Exploration Guide → Participation Tasks. Reach Activity 100 for the full premium daily payout.

title: Circle Bounty (Battle Pass)
description: Claim daily Circle Bounty EXP and collect level rewards. Target 12,000 EXP/week.

title: Manage Café by Origen
description: Collect earnings, restock 24h/72h depending on schedule. ~4,800+ Fons/day baseline.

title: Nacupeda's Pool Blessing
description: Bridge Crossing fountain. Sincere Wish for Mhm! Coins. Buff also boosts Fons income — do early.

title: Fortune Reading at Witch's House (×3)
description: Southwest of Hankaku Street. 3 draws/day → Bless / Treasure Hunt / Lost Tales. Unmarked, easy to miss.

title: Give 10 gifts to characters
description: Cap 10/day, max 3/character. Edgar first (R10 = weekly reward). Use Fluffy Cotton from Boom Boom Cloud (400 Affection).

title: Farm Fons with Chiz
description: Hold Chiz basic attack on enemies. 40k/day cap; 250k–500k lifetime cap.

title: Claim free daily Module (Hathor Hamster Ball)
description: Track Little Melon Seeds → Haunted Vending Machines → upgrade Hamster Ball → claim Module.

title: Date / map bond encounters
description: Cinema/Ferris Wheel = +200 bond. 3 map bond encounters/day for additional bond EXP.

title: Pray at Fortune Shades Tree
description: Yuanmu Hill (far east). Optional affinity activity.

title: Bust illegal activities
description: Open-world patrol. Daily limited Fons + side materials.
